summary: /music queue now pages through long queues with Previous/Next buttons instead of truncating into one message, and "Now playing" auto-advance notifications are sent silently (no push notification).
details: Only attaches the buttons when the queue is longer than one page (10 tracks) -- a short queue still gets a single plain reply.

Each button click re-fetches the guild's live queue state rather than reusing a stale snapshot, so the page reflects reality even if tracks finished, were skipped, or more were queued while the message sat in the channel.
The view's buttons disable themselves after 3 minutes of inactivity.
